title: Staircase With Variable Steps
description:
You climb a staircase of n steps. In one move you may climb any number of steps from 1 up to k. Different orders of moves count as different ways (for example 1 then 2 is different from 2 then 1).

Print the number of ways to reach exactly step n, modulo 1000000007.

Input format
One line with two integers n and k.

Output format
One integer: the number of ways modulo 1000000007.
hints: Let ways[i] be the number of ways to reach step i. How can you reach step i from earlier steps?
The last move was some size s between 1 and k, so ways[i] is the sum of ways[i - s] for s = 1..k (only where i - s >= 0). ways[0] = 1.
Summing k values for every step is O(n * k) and may be too slow. Keep a running window sum of the last k values: add ways[i - 1], subtract ways[i - k - 1]. Apply the modulo at every step.
